_meta.description: Fabricator recipes. The fabricator converts raw materials into useful items. Each recipe has a wear cost (deterministic, declared per recipe) and is subject to the fabricator's misfire curve. Phase 1 ships with a starter set — recipe book grows as content is written.
_meta.misfire_curve: Derived from fabricator health. See tag_registry fabricator_state. 100hp=0%, 80hp=2%, 60hp=8%, 40hp=18%, 20hp=35%, 10hp=55%, 0hp=80%.
_meta.misfire_outcomes: ~85% waste (materials consumed, nothing produced). ~15% produces fab_surplus item. Below 20% health, misfires can break the fabricator entirely.
_meta.microgame_option: Player can play the fab_align microgame instead of blind fabrication. Success = guaranteed output (no misfire). Failure = normal misfire roll applies.

recipes.name: Hull Patch
recipes.description: Basic hull repair material. The ship needs these more than it should.

recipes.name: Field Repair Kit
recipes.description: General-purpose repair supplies. More expensive than buying at a station, but stations aren't always there.

recipes.name: Crop Treatment Solution
recipes.description: Nutrient solution for sick crops. The botanist approves. The fabricator is indifferent.
recipes.gameplay_effect: Restores 20 crop health when used. One use.

recipes.name: Emergency Fuel Cell
recipes.description: Improvised fuel. Not as good as station fuel. Better than drifting.
recipes.gameplay_effect: Restores 15 fuel when used. One use. Requires Field Repair Fabricator upgrade.

recipes.name: O2 Canister
recipes.description: Compressed oxygen. The process is louder than it needs to be.
recipes.gameplay_effect: Restores 10 O2 when used. One use. Requires Field Repair Fabricator upgrade.
